competency_definitions.C01: Distinguish relevant information, causes and effects, and analyze factor relationships within systems.
competency_definitions.C02: Set goals, task sequences, resources, and time in a systematic way.
competency_definitions.C03: Identify causes, generate alternatives, evaluate outcomes, and solve system-level problems.
competency_definitions.C04: Inspect data, documents, numbers, conditions, and discrepancies accurately.
competency_definitions.C05: Communicate information, instructions, and reports clearly, and coordinate with stakeholders.
competency_definitions.C06: Cooperate, share roles, listen, and work effectively with teams and other units.
competency_definitions.C07: Set direction, delegate, monitor, and develop teams to achieve goals.
competency_definitions.C08: Make decisions based on data, risk, cost, time, and impact.
competency_definitions.C09: Use domain-specific software systems (ERP, CRM, POS, etc.) and related digital tools.
competency_definitions.C10: Read, manage, analyze, and communicate meaning from data and metrics.
competency_definitions.C11: Understand customer needs and maintain service levels.
competency_definitions.C12: Negotiate terms, prices, timing, services, and mutual benefits.
competency_definitions.C13: Adapt plans and working methods when conditions, technologies, or situations change.
competency_definitions.C14: Comply with laws, standards, safety practices, and organizational requirements.
competency_definitions.C15: Consider resources, energy, environmental impact, and sustainability in professional practice.

career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL01: Manage inbound receiving, storage, inventory control, picking, and warehouse space efficiency.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL02: Plan and control vehicles, routes, transport schedules, costs, deliveries, and field events.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL03: Plan demand, supply, production, and materials, and balance plans across the supply chain.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL04: Analyze data, KPIs, processes, and models to improve logistics performance.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL05: Source suppliers, compare offers, negotiate terms, manage costs, risks, and categories.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL06: Coordinate import-export operations, carriers, documents, schedules, and international customers.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL07: Prepare and verify documentation; handle customs and trade regulations, safety, and goods requirements.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL08: Analyze, design, deploy, and improve WMS/TMS/ERP/automation systems and digital data.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL09: Reduce waste, carbon, and energy; manage product returns; integrate sustainability into supply chains.
career_descriptions_by_cluster.CL10: Manage projects, teams, processes, strategy, stakeholders, and organizational change.
